statuses.available: implemented, tested, documented and supported (module tier stable or beta)
statuses.experimental: implemented behind an explicit flag or experimental API, with known limitations
statuses.unsupported: out of scope or not guaranteed

capabilities.title: Write a memory through the ingest screens
capabilities.user_problem: I need memories stored with provenance, and secrets or injections kept out.
limitations: Screens catch known patterns only; a novel injection can pass.
A plausible first claim about something the store has never seen cannot be checked (staging run).

capabilities.title: Retrieve with tenant, scope and lifecycle enforced
capabilities.user_problem: An agent must only see memories it may use now.
limitations: Lexical ranking by default; recall@1 is low when many notes share a tag (research/results/product-bench.md).

capabilities.title: Explain where a memory came from
capabilities.user_problem: I need to know why the system remembers this.
limitations: Only provenance the system recorded can be shown.

capabilities.title: Lineage of ancestors and descendants
capabilities.user_problem: I need to see what was derived from a memory.
limitations: Depth-bounded; lineage recorded by callers through parents only.

capabilities.title: Version and event history of a memory
capabilities.user_problem: I need to see how a memory changed and who changed it.

capabilities.title: Preview and apply a withdrawal, with stale-preview protection
capabilities.user_problem: Before withdrawing a memory I need to see what it touches, and the preview must still hold when applied.
limitations: Recipients outside this store report on themselves; delivery is verified only by their acknowledgement.

capabilities.title: Retraction propagates to descendants and peers
capabilities.user_problem: A withdrawn memory must not survive in copies or conclusions.
limitations: A peer that never acknowledges stays pending; it is shown, not forced.
Restatements of a value (notes not linked by lineage) are contested only on a revision or a withdrawal recorded as contradicted.

capabilities.title: Status labels with stated limits
capabilities.user_problem: I need to know what the store has and has not established about a memory.
limitations: No label says a memory is true.

capabilities.title: Contradictions kept as competing claims
capabilities.user_problem: When sources disagree I need both claims, not a silent overwrite.
limitations: Detected for structured claims and value statements; free-text disagreement can be missed.

capabilities.title: Action-time re-check of every memory an action relies on
capabilities.user_problem: A memory withdrawn after it was read must not drive an action.
limitations: Covers tools run through the gate only.

capabilities.title: Tenant isolation on every access path
capabilities.user_problem: One tenant must never read or infer another's memories.
limitations: Single store; tenants share a process and its keys.

capabilities.title: Session compaction into one governed summary
capabilities.user_problem: A later session cannot read every turn of an earlier one.
limitations: One summary per episode; no hierarchy.

capabilities.title: Context receipts: what an agent was given, and what was excluded and why
capabilities.user_problem: I need to reproduce and explain exactly what context an agent received.
limitations: Token counts are estimates (characters / 4), not a tokenizer.
Exclusions list candidates retrieval returned; memories below the relevance floor are not listed.

capabilities.title: Governed Context Map: source-linked summaries, invalidation and a budgeted planner
capabilities.user_problem: Long histories must fit a token budget without losing their sources or using stale summaries.
limitations: extractive-v1 keeps every distinct fact verbatim, so it saves tokens only on restatements and chatter.
Summary nodes live in process memory and are rebuilt per process.

capabilities.title: Governed decay view: recent memories whole, older ones summarised, agent-written summaries
capabilities.user_problem: A session needs what is currently known within a fixed budget, without withdrawn or superseded values.
limitations: Pre-registered bars narrowly not met (research/results/decay-view.md), though the view beat recency on every seed.
Inspired by OptMem's published design; no OptMem code is used (upstream has no licence).
With real local models the registered bar was missed (qwen2.5:7b 0.12, llama3.1:8b 0.53 of the headroom); model summaries can pick an older real value, which the check cannot catch.

capabilities.title: Branches, commits, diff and governance-aware merge
capabilities.user_problem: I need to try memory changes in isolation and merge them with conflicts surfaced.
limitations: No branch of a branch; merges go into main only.
Branch retrieval is the overlay view; it is not ranked by the store's retrieval arms.

capabilities.title: Signed federation between stores, with key rotation
capabilities.user_problem: Stores on different machines must share validated memories and retractions safely.
limitations: No consensus; each store decides for itself.

capabilities.title: Cryptographic erasure of content
capabilities.user_problem: Deleted personal data must not be recoverable from history.
limitations: Backups taken before erasure hold their own copy until they expire (docs/LIMITATIONS.md).

capabilities.title: Hash-chained log with checkpoints
capabilities.user_problem: I need to detect a rewritten or truncated history.
limitations: Detects rewrites against a checkpoint held elsewhere; does not prevent them.

capabilities.title: Read-only operator dashboard
capabilities.user_problem: An operator needs to see the store without changing it.
limitations: Read-only by design; changes go through the CLI or SDK.

capabilities.title: Release evidence and product benchmark for the exact commit
capabilities.user_problem: Release numbers must come from the commit being released.
limitations: Synthetic corpus; one process.

capabilities.title: Compliance certification
capabilities.user_problem: A regulator asks for a certificate.
limitations: No external audit has been done (docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md O7). No legal review of deletion semantics.
